## Plugin reference

- Description: `/mermaid` in the page editor: turns the caret's line into a code block set to mermaid, shown split — its source above the drawn diagram (the code-preview registry draws it).
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Editor.InsertAction` "Mermaid diagram"
  - Uses: `page/editor.Editor`
